competitive_landscape: San Pedro Belize Express and Ocean Ferry dominate the diesel water-taxi corridor. Tropic Air and Maya Island Air handle the small-plane spokes. No electric / foiling tier exists. The corridor's protected reef water and incumbent diesel fleet make this one of the cleanest replace-and-upgrade plays in the Navier backlog.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the airport-to-resort premium transfer tier — PGI↔San Pedro (~35 nm), San Pedro local resort jetties — plus the Hol Chan / Shark-Ray Alley tender — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on flat protected reef water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: N35 Shuttle is the volume corridor platform — Belize City↔Caye Caulker↔San Pedro (~20–35 nm). Hybrid Quanta-LR is the longer-horizon Belize↔Quintana Roo / Yucatán trunk option (~150 nm) with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

precedents.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the dense, short-hop reef-corridor electrification playbook the Belize cayes corridor reproduces under a UNESCO reef regime.

regulatory_note: Belize Port Authority regulates passenger water transport. UNESCO Belize Barrier Reef Reserve System (1996, formerly threatened-list 2009–2018) — strong conservation regime with active Hol Chan, Bacalar Chico, South Water Caye marine reserves. CITES + MARPOL apply via Belize Maritime.
seasonality: Year-round operability; dry season (December–April) is peak tourism, wet season (June–November) brings occasional tropical-storm windows but the corridor inside the reef stays generally workable. Hurricane risk is real but seasonal and well-modelled.

summary: The Belize City ↔ Caye Caulker ↔ San Pedro (Ambergris Caye) water-taxi corridor — operated by San Pedro Belize Express and Ocean Ferry — is a dense, year-round tourist plus commuter route of short hops (~20–35 nm) running entirely inside the Belize Barrier Reef. The water is flat and protected, near-ideal for hydrofoiling. High frequency, strong cruise plus resort demand, and incumbent diesel water-taxis to displace — top-tier Navier fit. Sovereign country with no built node adjacency.
